parsed.note: The post only reports a regression, reverts to a prior commit, and proposes changing MATRIX_LR (0.05 -> 0.06), which is in the freely-editable hyperparameter section; it does not touch TRAIN_SHARDS, EVAL_SHARD, EVAL_SPLIT, or EVAL_TOKENS, so val_bpb continues to measure real model quality.
